## Summary

One-sentence description of the feature.

## Use case

Who needs this and why? Describe the workflow or problem it solves.

## Proposed solution

How you imagine this working. Code examples, CLI flags, or skill invocation patterns are helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, external libraries, or prior art.
